title: Defence against the dark arts of distillation: Unsupervised discovery of subliminal learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13536v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a language model is distilled from a teacher that shares its base parameters, the student can inherit behavioural traits of the teacher---including misalignment---even from data that is semantically unrelated to the trait (Cloud et al., 2026). All existing defences require knowing the trait. We remove this requirement and prove that a subliminally transferred trait can be recovered from the parameter updates alone, without supervision, by exploiting a single asymmetry: the trait is expressed consistently across diverse datasets generated by the teacher, whereas task-specific and shared capabilities vary. The resulting estimator returns a weight-space direction that can be amplified to discover and interpret the trait or projected out to suppress it. translated_title: 防御蒸馏的黑魔法：阈下学习的无监督发现
translated_abstract: 当语言模型从共享其基础参数的教师模型蒸馏而来时，学生模型可能会继承教师模型的行为特征——包括失对齐——即使训练数据在语义上与该特征无关。现有的所有防御方法都需要预先知道该特征。我们移除了这一要求，并证明通过利用一个关键的不对称性——阈下传递的特征在教师模型生成的多样化数据集上保持一致表达，而任务特定能力和共享能力则各不相同——可以仅凭参数更新，在无监督条件下恢复该特征。由此得到的估计器会返回一个权重空间方向，放大该方向即可发现并解释该特征，或将其投影出去以抑制该特征。在阈下学习基准测试中，我们的方法在没有任何特征标签的情况下成功恢复了传递的动物偏好特征，并抑制了其表达。
tldr: 提出了一种无需预先知晓目标特征的无监督防御方法，仅通过分析学生模型的参数更新即可发现、解释并抑制从共享基础参数的教师模型阈下继承的失对齐行为特征。
en_tdlr: An unsupervised defence that discovers, interprets, and suppresses subliminally inherited misaligned traits from parameter updates alone, without requiring any prior knowledge of the trait.
